events.verdict: Camara (POR) moves forward into Poeltl's (TOR) space and initiates body contact as he defends the shot.
Poeltl (TOR) aligns himself along Avdija's (POR) path and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Poeltl (TOR) avoids making contact with Avdija's (POR) head as he defends the shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) contests Barnes (TOR)"s jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Sharpe (POR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful.  While the ball is last touched by Portland, Quickley (TOR) moves into Sharpe's space and delivers contact that affects his SQBR.  The contact is proximate to the out of bounds, and a personal foul is assessed to Quickley upon replay review.
Shead (TOR) establishes himself in Grant's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Ingram (TOR) establishes himself in Cissoko's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Avdija (POR) and Poeltl (TOR) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Shead (TOR) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Trail Blazers.

Replay review of the foul called on Avdija (POR) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Avdija extends his arm into Shead (TOR) and initiates contact that affects his ability to defend the drive.
Shead (TOR) establishes himself in Camara's (POR) path prior to the contact.
Shead (TOR) swipes his arm down and initiates contact with Avdija's (POR) arm prior to the shot being blocked by Barnes (TOR).
Cissoko (POR) commits a take foul on Ingram (TOR).
Ingram (TOR) legally contests the jump shot attempt and incidental foot contact occurs as Grant (POR) returns to the floor.
Sharpe (POR) commits a take foul on Ingram (TOR).
